{{Term/Store|Padda||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|Padda|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Padda|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref>

==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Padda is a [[Gerudo Soldier]] who can be found in the [[Palace Courtyard]]. Her duty is to care of [[Riju]]'s [[Sand Seal]], [[Patricia]].<ref>{{Cite|Anyway, I make sure to care for Patricia so that she'll be ready at a moment's notice from the chief.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> In addition to this, she also watches out for Riju while she is in Gerudo Town, and she worries whenever she leaves.<ref>{{Cite|I'm not just taking care of Patricia, you know... I also keep an eye on the {{Color BotW|Blue|chief}} whenever she's in town. And I worry for her when she's away...|Padda|BotW}}</ref> She carries a [[Gerudo Shield]] and a [[Moonlight Scimitar]].

The first time [[Link]] speaks to Padda, she introduces Patricia as Riju's favorite Sand Seal, and she explains that Patricia is an oracle who offers wisdom in return for [[Fruit]].<ref>{{Cite|Sav'saaba. Are you a traveler? Sitting here is the {{Color BotW|Blue|chief}}'s favorite {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}}, Patricia. But she's no ordinary {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}}... She's actually something of an oracle! If you offer fruit to Patricia by placing it before her, you'll receive some words of wisdom in return!|Padda|BotW}}</ref> If Link speaks to her again, she recalls that Riju used to visit everyday, but as of late, she has been too busy to allow herself to relax.<ref>{{Cite|I used to see {{Color BotW|Blue|the chief}} around here every day... But she's been so busy lately, I don't think she's allowed herself even a moment to relax. Such responsibility at such a young age...|Padda|BotW}}</ref> Padda then apologizes for rambling on and encourages Link to offer Fruit to Patricia.<ref>{{Cite|Ah, I apologize. I'm just going on and on and on... If you'd like some words of wisdom, just offer Patricia some fruit.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> While Patricia likes all types of Fruit, Padda reveals that she likes [[Wildberry|Wildberries]] the best.<ref>{{Cite|Patricia does have a particular fondness for {{Color BotW|Blue|wildberries}}, but she'll happily accept any kind of fruit.|Padda|BotW}}</ref>

Padda has the ability to communicate with Patricia and understand her divine messages.<ref>{{Cite|Patricia has a mysterious power... If you feed some fruit to her, she will deliver divine messages. But the messages can only be understood by those who are able to truly communicate with her.|Riju|BotW}}</ref> When Link offers Fruits to Patricia, Padda will translate her responses for him. If Patricia does not like the Fruit, Padda will relay her message as "Seal the deal on your fortune by using more valuable fruit!" and comment that she could not avoid using Patricia's Seal pun.<ref>{{Cite|"Seal the deal on your fortune by using more valuable fruit!" Yeah, there was no avoiding that pun.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> If Patricia likes the Fruit, Padda will translate for her, which includes information on Sand Seals,<ref>{{Cite|"Sand seals can be knocked out by the sound of an explosion. I'm se— ...Serious." That was a close one. She tried to slip a seal pun in there.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> [[Sand Boots]] and [[Snow Boots]],<ref>{{Cite|"{{Color BotW|Blue|Sand boots}} for desert sands and {{Color BotW|Blue|snow boots}} for...serious snowfall." I've spared you the painful seal pun.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> [[Heat]],<ref>{{Cite|"The southern desert is...searing hot during the day! Bring {{Color BotW|Blue|gear made for it}}!" I've spared you the painful seal pun.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> [[Molduga]]s,<ref>{{Cite|"{{Color BotW|Blue|Molduga}} eat anything—even bombs. That's a rather...serious diet!" I've spared you the painful seal pun.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> [[Farosh]],<ref>{{Cite|"Look to the top of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Gerudo Highlands}} to sea...SEE...the path to a dragon." *sigh* I've spared you the seal pun.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> the [[Statue of the Eighth Heroine]],<ref>{{Cite|"{{Color BotW|Blue|Risoka Snowfield}} rests upon the shoulders of the eighth heroine..." A rare, pun-free prophecy...|Padda|BotW}}</ref> and [[Tera's Great Fairy Fountain]].<ref>{{Cite|"The location a dragon drifts to is also the goal of those...seeking a great fairy." I've spared you the painful seal pun.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> After every translation, Padda thanks Patricia for her wisdom.<ref>{{Cite|... Thank you for your wisdom, kind Patricia! We're very grateful!|Padda|BotW}}</ref>

After Link calms [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]], Padda reveals that she can feel the stress lifting from Gerudo Town, which she is sure Riju feels as well.<ref>{{Cite|I can't see what's going on outside from here, but... I heard that Naboris has calmed at last. I can almost feel the stress rising off the shoulders of the townsfolk. I'm sure the chief feels it too.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> When Riju is sitting in the courtyard, Padda tells Link to behave.<ref>{{Cite|You are in the chief's presence now. Please behave appropriately.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> However, she only asks this because Riju has returned to her regular self, and Padda wants to protect her happiness.<ref>{{Cite|I ask this because she appears to have returned to her normal, kind self. It's such a relief to see her happy again. I consider it my duty to protect her good mood at all costs.|Padda|BotW}}</ref> She then reminds Link that he can offer Fruits to Patricia to hear wisdom, even though Riju is present.<ref>{{Cite|Er... I'm blathering again, huh... You can receive words of wisdom even when the chief is here. Just offer Patricia some fruit if you desire some of her insight.|Padda|BotW}}</ref>

==Trivia==
* Padda is one of several characters that will hit [[Link]] back if he attacks them with a [[Weapon]].<ref>{{Cite|Bring it on!|Padda|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|What are you doing?!|Padda|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|You looking to fight?!|Padda|BotW}}</ref> These attacks deal no damage.
